summary: Client only. Works with the game's Scaleform (Flash) interface. element() controls an existing interface element, and createScreen() builds your own screen in the game's style. Calls that give an answer go to the game and return about a frame later.

addMenuButton.summary: Adds your resource's button to the game's Esc menu, above 'Report a bug', each time it opens. A click calls the handler with the button's id. The menu has room for two, so it returns null when both are taken. A click closes the menu, as the game's own entries do, so your handler can open its own page over the game.

params.label: The text, 1 to 64 characters.
params.handler: Called with the button's id on a click.

removeMenuButton.summary: Removes one of your resource's Esc menu buttons. Returns false for any other id.
removeMenuButton.exampleLua:
-- client
local NativeUI = kcds.ui.NativeUI

local rules = NativeUI.addMenuButton("Rules", function() return kcds.core.Events.toServer("rules:show") end)
NativeUI.removeMenuButton(rules)

element.summary: An object for one of the game's interface elements, by name, such as HUD or Menu.

params.elementName: The element's name in the game.

createScreen.summary: Opens your own screen: a game movie with an empty root clip to build on, or a movie your resource ships. Wait for 'ready' before building.

params.options: Optional: `library`, the game movie, with a default host if left out; `movie`, a .swf your resource ships; `assets`, up to 64 shipped files it loads; `layer`, its place in the game's UI stack.

createScreen.exampleLua:
-- client
local board = kcds.ui.NativeUI.createScreen()

board:on("ready", function()
  local panel = board.root:createClip()
  panel:draw({ { "beginFill", 0x15130f, 80 }, { "moveTo", 0, 0 }, { "lineTo", 400, 0 }, { "lineTo", 400, 200 }, { "lineTo", 0, 200 }, { "endFill" } })
  local title = panel:createText({ x = 20, y = 20, width = 360, height = 40, text = "Town board" })
  title:setTextStyle({ font = "DisplayFont", size = 24 })
  board:setVisible(true)
end)

libraries.summary: The symbols game movies export for NativeClip.attach, as { name, movie, exports } per element, or null if unreadable.
libraries.exampleLua:
-- client
for _, library in ipairs(kcds.ui.NativeUI.libraries() or {}) do
  print(library.name, #library.exports)
end

setMenuEnabled.summary: Sets whether the player can open a game menu page: 'crafting', 'inventory', 'player', 'map', 'codex' or 'journal'. A page stays closed while any resource disables it.

isMenuEnabled.summary: Whether a menu page can be opened.
